t: Pipulate: Building Sovereign Software – Nix, Local AI, and the Electron Alternative
s: Pipulate champions computational sovereignty by rejecting resource-heavy Electron apps and cloud-centric models, instead using Nix to create reproducible, local-first environments for an AI-native software stack, enabling individual control and radical transparency.
sub: Pipulate's Nix-based local-first architecture as an Electron alternative.
Achieving computational sovereignty by sidestepping cloud vendor lock-in and planned obsolescence.
Designing an AI-native stack with radical transparency and minimal surface area.
Iterative 'chisel-strike' approach to refining development tools and context generation.
